text:
Maya R: FYI postmortem's up for the recurring GPU pool spike that bumped p95 last week. want to align on remediation owners + whether we touch SLOs or add guardrails.
Dan C: link to postmortem https://redwood.internal/pm/2026-pool-spike — root cause appears to be KVCACHE eviction storms during bursty tokenization loads.
Ashley P: agree we need owners. quick question: are we considering relaxing the p95 SLO or adding a temporary error-budget reset?
Leo H: I'd prefer not to relax SLOs permanently. option: add a temporary tolerance window + tighter mitigations (pool isolation, canaries) and revisit after 2 weeks.
ops-oncall: ops data — we breached error budget twice in Q1 for this service. if we don't add throttles/fallbacks we'll keep burning. request pool-level isolation ASAP.
incident-bot: Incident 2026 closed — root cause annotated: kvcache_eviction_burst -> queue buildup. duration 00:18:34.
Maya R: Proposal (short): 1) Dashboard & alert work (Leo) — p50/p95/p99 + kvcache_hit_rate + queue_length, add incident annotations. 2) Pool isolation config (Dan) — tenant isolation + burst throttle. 3) Canary + rollback runbook (Ashley) — traffic ramp + auto-fallback to smaller model variant. 4) 2-week audit window, no permanent SLO change yet. Deadlines: Leo Tue EOD, Dan Fri EOD, Ashley next Wed.
Dan C: ok on ownership. for dashboards, we should include burn-rate and rolling error budget window. suggested prometheus queries: ```
// p95 latency by model_variant
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_variant))

// kvcache hit rate
sum(rate(kvcache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kvcache_requests_total[5m]))
```
Leo H: i'll add those panels + a single-pane summary showing current burn rate and last 6 incidents. will also mark the postmortem timeline on the graph.
Ashley P: I'll own the canary plan and rollback steps. plan: ramp 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 30m with automatic rollback if p95 > 350ms for 60s. will add the runbook and a small automated job to flip model_variant tag.
Maya R: important: do NOT change the published SLO number now. instead add a "guardrail" alert that triggers when projected burn exceeds 2x over 1h. that buys ops time without normalizing the lower bar.
Dan C: agreed. i'll implement pool isolation config + throttle and open a PR with config + test plan. tagging infra for review. PR will include a quick experiment to force kvcache eviction pattern in staging.
ops-oncall: i'll take week1 of the audit rotation (monitoring + incident annotation). volunteers for weeks 2-4?
Leo H: i'll take week2.
Ashley P: i'll do week3 and cover the canary verification.
Dan C: i'll do week4 and own the config rollouts.
Maya R: i'll create the action tracker in the postmortem doc and assign owners + due dates. i'll ping owners in #eng-platform when PRs/boards are created.
Dan C: note for the tracker: include a code snippet for the alert (Alertmanager): ```
- alert: SLOBurnProjectionHigh
  expr: predict_linear(sum(rate(error_budget_burn[1m])[5m]), 3600) > (2 * error_budget_rate)
  for: 2m
```
Ashley P: drafting rollback runbook now, will link in tracker.
Leo H: dashboards done, pushing to grafana staging, will send link here.
Maya R: thanks all — checkins: quick sync Thu morning 09:30 to review progress. if blockers pop up, ping me + ops-oncall. :thumbsup:
